body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Choose a detected enemy within 5 units. Gain +1 to the Defense targeted by its next attack against you until the start of your next turn; learn its remaining Reaction Dice.

surges.html: Move 1 unit toward a space with a clear view of it.
Gain the defensive benefit against a second detected enemy within 5 units.

rider.title: Strain - Trance
rider.html: Enter Interval Trance until the end of your next turn: the first time the chosen enemy misses you during the Trance, you may remove 1 Strain, provided you accepted none on this card.
